findings.summary: In `releaseForRetry`, `target_receipt_id` is incorrectly set to `NULL`, which resets `attempt_count` to 1 on the next claim for the same target, causing graceful transient failures to incorrectly evade attempt limits unlike ungraceful lease expirations.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove `target_receipt_id = NULL,` from the `UPDATE` statement in `releaseForRetry` so the target is preserved and `attemptCount` can increment correctly on retry. Additionally, update the transient failure test in `postgresPolicyInsightSynthesisTriggerAdapter.test.ts` to expect `row.target_receipt_id` to equal `id2`.
